meals.name: Kefir & Strawberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Feta
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of two fried eggs on toasted sourdough bread topped with crumbled feta, a glass of pink kefir strawberry smoothie and fresh strawberries on the side, natural morning light on a white ceramic plate
day_of_steps: 1. Pour 250 ml kefir into a blender, add 80 g strawberries for Diego (60 g for Diana) and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass.
2. Toast 40 g sourdough slice for Diego (30 g for Diana) in a toaster.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with 1 tsp olive oil. Fry 2 eggs for Diego, 2 eggs for Diana to desired doneness.
4. Place eggs on toasted sourdough. Crumble 30 g feta on Diego's plate, 20 g feta on Diana's plate.
5. Serve with 1 medium orange (peeled, segmented) each. Drink 500 ml water.

5. Plate: rice first, then green beans and carrots, then salmon on top. Drizzle any pan juices over.
6. Serve with 500 ml water.
